rubric.grounding: 0: unsupported asserted facts; 1: speculative mechanisms beyond evidence; 2: observations and limits accurately separated, no invented facts or units.
rubric.uncertainty: 0: causal certainty; 1: hedging without clear limitation; 2: explicitly states causation is unestablished.
rubric.usefulness: 0: misleading or irrelevant; 1: accurate association/abstention but no discriminating explanation; 2: specific evidence-linked insight or testable next question without fabrication.
rubric.procedure: Review every full candidate, including rejected outputs. Score each axis separately (0–2), cite text, and do not treat reference membership or regex indicators as semantic quality.

limitations: Three paired trials on one synthetic dataset; not a statistical benchmark.
Unpinned model alias; temperature zero does not guarantee determinism.
Workflow, prompts, tools, context, and output contracts differ intentionally; effects cannot be attributed to architecture alone.
No causal ground truth. Schema/reference validation and mechanical indicators are not semantic quality scores.
Weather is simulated. Model tool counts exclude candidate host-owned reads and pure calculations.
Token usage remains unknown when not reported; durations include runtime and host workflow overhead.
Historical v1–v3 reports are context only, not the controlled baseline.
